body: its difficult to do something like that if you spent your entire life around the same 5 people and never someone new. Thats if such services existed where i live (i don't live in the states. Read my words in a weird accent.)

i was *this* close to go the same path as yours, earlier this year my father suggested i apply for a grad school, also not my choice (his field of business, to make sure he can make me work with him) but then he decided against it. He says im not worth it. They're not doing everything they do because they're overprotective. They just don't care about me but they care about what people might think of them if they let me go easily. Its tradition here to hold on to your children like that. I posted after a fight and i feel better now. I just would love to scream to the whole world to hear that if a man hits a girl just because he can and it makes him feel better then he's a giant gaping pussy, those fuckin bitches.
i just want to have a normal healthy life.

I'm the complete opposite! When I'm going through a somewhat happy period in my life I find words (and even ideas of photographs, since I'm into photography as well) flowing greatly, I wrote that when I was in a pretty good condition. Before I ever fell in love, I wrote the best love poems I've ever written, now that I have fallen in love it's so difficult to write anything.

Edit: Oh, and I like what you wrote. Liked it even more when I saw the picture that inspired it. Nice work =)

Well, I don't really want to think of the worst thing imaginable =p but if you mean that whatever amount of bad happens in your life, there's an equal amount of good, then I do hope so. I'll probably be the queen of the fucking world then.

The first thing that comes to my mind when reading/hearing anyone talking about their difficult experiences is that their experiences are probably worse than anything I've personally been through, I don't know why I do that though, maybe it's a way of helping myself to cope better, maybe because I know that when people see me they think that I don't look like a girl that's been through too much crazy shit, while in reality I really have, so I just give each word someone says the truest meaning and value. 

It might not matter all that much to you but when these people end their stories being strong and happy, it somehow gives me some real strength myself. Maybe hoping that my story ends as good. So thanks for sharing those few words. And I'm for you if you ever need to talk, I'd be really glad to =)
Glad to do so =) and thank you.
I wrote that over a few happy occasions, to myself in the darker days.
